description: Lists the six ready-made characters (person, kid, dog, cat, bird, monster): legs, views, the colour slots a cast entry's look.colors paints on each (a dog's fur is skin), options, page and links; the voices a line can use; and cartoon_example, a whole talking cartoon to copy. Call it to write a cast: {"dog": {"name": "Biscuit", "look": {"template": "dog", "colors": {"skin": "#8d6e63"}}, "voice": "am_puck"}}.
name: list_characters
title: List Jabbertoon's ready-made cartoon characters and voices
